title: Velista: the compact view and the reel
lede: Plans 0202, 0203 and 0204. The row of 0191 with the button stepper becomes the default view; the compact view is the two line row with the reel of 0043 restored, stepping by today's rule. A picker in the header of the zone list and of the basket chooses between them. Every frame is drawn Day in Spanish and Night in English, at 390 by 844, from the source on dev at e06813139 and the reel as it was deleted at d8daa824c^. The lines and prices are sample data. Photos are the Open Food Facts copies from ../typeahead/photos, CC BY-SA 3.0. Generated from the committed *.dc.html artboards and the notes in canvas.json. The design: icon set B and its header button "2"; the picker on the zone list header, and on the basket in the tools row and in the basket's menu; the filter button is a funnel, a new icon, on every zone list header and on the basket's tools row; every reel is 52 by 44 with the unit under the number, in every frame and on the open tape; Due rows say only "Add". Approved by the owner on 2026-11-22. Round 6 adds the question a raised line asks when units were bought above its ask. Not yet approved.

annotations.text:
WHICH PLAN EACH FRAME ANSWERS.
Picker, Icons and Basket: velista 0202, section 1, frames 1 and 2.
Default and Compact: 0202 frame 3, and 0203 frames 1 and 5. The two boards draw the same ten lines, so the rows can be counted side by side.
Reel open: 0203 frame 2 and spec 2.
Due rows: 0203 frame 3. Product page: 0203 frame 4.
Row sheet: 0204, the one frame it asks for, under the rewritten 0200 and 0201.
Every zone list frame draws the header of velista 0205: the list's name, and under it "in Casa" / "en Casa" in the small muted size, both inside the 64 px block. The head block above the search field has no group line.

MEASURED ON THESE FRAMES.
The control: the stepper is 155 by 48. The reel is 52 by 44 in every frame, the number over its unit.
Room for words at 390: in the compact row the name and its price share 238 px; the same two line row with the stepper left them 135 px.
Rows: the default row is 99 px, the compact row 68 px. Between the search field and the bar there are 629 px, now that the group line sits in the header (velista 0205): six rows and a third of the seventh in the default view, nine and a quarter in the compact one. About 45 percent more rows on a screen.

DECIDED BY THE OWNER.
Icon set B, and its header button ("2").
The picker on the zone list header, and on the basket in the tools row and in the basket's menu (no fourth header action).
One size for every reel, 52 by 44 with the unit under the number.
Due rows say only "Add".
The funnel replaces the sliders for the filter on the zone list header and on the basket's tools row (board Icons).
The words as drawn: "Normal" for Default in Spanish, and Compact as a name with "More rows on the screen" under it, because one line with a colon wraps at 276 px.

NO SCREENSHOTS OF TODAY.
The staging test account in tmp/velista-user-staging no longer signs in: staging refused it on 2026-11-22 with "that email and password do not match". The production copy onto staging of 2026-11-19 probably replaced it. So every frame is drawn from source, and the default view board stands in for today's row.

THE PICKER.
The first header action on the zone list, before the filter, as plan 0202 asks (beside the filter). Its name is "View" / "Vista". The popover is the choice frame of AnchoredPopover: 276 px, rows to its edges, the raised surface, the hairline and the second elevation. The current row carries the tick in the quiet amber and the heavier weight; that is the only accent.

THE TAPE RUNS SIDEWAYS.
As the reel of 0043 did: previous, current and next in a row, 56 px tall, growing left from the reel. It covers its own row's name and price; on a 68 px row it stays inside the row and only its shadow reaches the rows above and below. Plan 0203 frame 2 says "over the next row"; this is that overlay as it was built. A tape that runs down over the next row would be a new gesture, not a restore.
A weight writes its words on the tape: 975 g, 1 kg, 1,05 kg. The spec's 925, 950, 975, 1000, 1050 are the same steps in grams.

TWO CHANGES TO THE OLD PILL.
The restored pill had a minimum width of 52 and grew with its words, so "1,5 kg" made a wider reel than "6" and the column broke. The box is fixed at 52 by 44 with the unit under the number, so every value fits and the column holds. Everything else is the old stylesheet: the subtle border, 12 px radius, the zero style with no fill.
The tape's neighbours print their unit at 11 px, the app's floor.

THE FUNNEL IS A NEW ICON.
No funnel exists in libs/velista/ui icons or in libs/shared/ui. This is a new glyph for libs/velista/ui/src/lib/icons/icons.ts, drawn at the 1.8 stroke and round joins of the header's other icons. It replaces the sliders of FilterIcon on every zone list header and on the basket's tools row, the real basket filter button included.
The build removes the comment on FilterIcon in icons.ts that chose the sliders over a funnel.
An active filter keeps today's mark: the glyph in the quiet amber and the count over its corner. The count badge's distance from the funnel is judged on a device after the build.

THE REEL, FINAL.
52 by 44, the unit under the number: number 15 px bold, unit 11 px, the size of the "/ kg" beside the price. The build needs two tokens: --app-quantity-width 52 px and --app-quantity-height 44 px.
The pill fills the 44 px tap box the reel already had, so the compact row stays 68 px.
The widest figure, "99,95", is 38.6 px at 15 px bold; the pill's inside is 46 px, so every value fits. A count has no unit and its number sits centred in the same box; its ceiling, 99 999, prints "100" over "K".
With the reel at 52 px the name and its price share 238 px in the compact row.
The reel takes snap points: 1000, and on the basket row sheet the list's ask. A drag lands exactly on a snap point even when the step would skip it.

THE ROW SHEET (0204).
The colours of 0201 move onto the reel: the resting number and every number on the tape are green when equal to the list's ask and amber above it. Both pass the contrast floor on the raised surface and on the tape: green 5.5 to 1 and amber 4.9 to 1 on Day, both above 8 to 1 on Night.
The label is "<list> · <ask>", the list name cut first and the ask never. No menu trigger on a row: plan 0200 dropped it. The lists' heading reads "What you bought" / "Lo que has comprado" (0201), with the text button "Lists and amounts" / "Listas y cantidades" on its right, which opens the detailed view (0200). "Bought for another list" draws reels too, from 0.

ROUND 6, THE WORDS PROPOSED (A). Every amount carries its unit, a count too (the owner).
ES: "Marta ya compró 1 ud de más. ¿Sigues necesitando 2 uds o solo 1 ud?" Answers: "Sigo necesitando" 2 uds, "Contar lo comprado de más" 1 ud.
EN: "Marta already bought 1 pc extra. Do you still need 2 pcs, or just 1 pc?" Answers: "Still need" 2 pcs, "Count the extra" 1 pc.
When the extra covers it: "¿Sigues necesitando 1 ud o con eso basta?" with "Sigo necesitando" 1 ud and "Con eso basta"; "Do you still need 1 pc, or is that enough?" with "Still need" 1 pc and "That's enough". Nothing says 0.
A weight: "Marta ya compró 500 g de más. ¿Sigues necesitando 1,5 kg o solo 1 kg?"
THE COUNT'S WORD. "uds" is the app's own, with no period: list.add.size.UNIT prints "12 uds". The app has no singular, so "ud" is proposed, written the same way. English has only the long "units" ("12 units"); "pc" / "pcs" is proposed, as the sample sizes on these boards already write "12 pcs". The build adds the four words as keys with a count, so 1 takes the singular.
"de más" and "extra" avoid a noun, so the Spanish needs no gender for "huevos" or "leche". B's question "¿Qué debe pedir la lista ahora?" does the same.

ROUND 6, THE FRAME.
The choice frame of AnchoredPopover (276 px, rows to the edges, the raised surface, the hairline, the second elevation) with the add choice's inside: a 15 px 600 title and 48 px rows. No icon and no tint, as the existing popovers have none.
It sits wholly above or wholly below the asked row, aligned to the row's end, its pointer's tip 3 to 4 px off the row's edge: below when the row is near the top of the screen (frames 1 and 4), above when it is near the bottom (frames 2, 3 and 5), as AnchoredPopover already flips between its two sides. Measured on this board: none of the 29 popovers, pointer included, overlaps its own row's box or its control, and every pointer's centre is on the control's centre (the stepper's or the reel's).
Focus starts on the first answer, the amount as set. Escape, a press outside and the back gesture close it like that answer.

A RULE FOR EVERY POPOVER THAT REFERS TO ONE CONTROL (the owner).
It has a pointer, a small arrow on its edge aimed at that control, so it cannot be taken for another row's. And it never hides what it points at: not the control, and not the row's name, price and picture.
This reaches every such popover, the disabled stepper's popover in ../basket-row-buys included.
AnchoredPopover (libs/velista/ui/src/lib/list/anchored-popover) has no pointer today: it flips between above and below, and that is all. The build adds one: a 12 px square turned 45 degrees, in the popover's own raised surface with its hairline on the two outer sides, so the pointer and the popover read as one shape. Its centre follows the anchor's centre on the side the popover opened.

WHEN IT SHOWS (the owner, ruled).
The popover opens only after the control's quiet beat has passed AND the save request has answered. A run of presses therefore asks once, about the amount the person stopped on.
By then the person may have scrolled on. If the row is no longer in view, the page scrolls to it by itself first (frame 8), placing it where the popover fits, then opens the question.
To be noticed, the row and the popover flash (frame 7), proposed in numbers: 3 pulses, each 600 ms (240 ms in, 120 ms held, 240 ms out), 200 ms apart, 2.2 s in all. The accent is the quiet amber at quiet strength: the row takes the quiet amber wash (the fill of the bar's current tab, 10 percent) and a 1.5 px outline, and the popover's border and pointer take the quiet amber text colour. No fill on the popover. Under prefers-reduced-motion nothing pulses: the accent frame holds steady for the same 2.2 s and then goes, and the scroll jumps instead of gliding.
Contrast in the accent frame: the smallest muted text (11 px) is 4.8 to 1 on the Day wash and 6.5 to 1 on the Night wash.

ROUND 6, FOR THE OWNER TO DECIDE.
1. The person left the page before the answer came. Ask when they come back to the list, or drop the question and keep the amount they set? Not drawn.
2. Closed without an answer: the amount set stands, as the owner's words suggest. Drawn as the default (board frame 6, left).
3. The next raise of the same line: proposed to ask again only while an extra remains that nobody counted. Once per line per trip is the other choice. Not drawn.
4. Several buyers: "Marta y Luis ya compraron 2 uds de más" for two, "3 personas ya compraron 3 uds de más" for more? Not drawn.
5. The line page's amount and the line sheet's amount: do they ask too? Drawn for the zone list rows only.
6. A reel that closes on its value: drawn as asking after it closes (frame 2), never while the tape is up.
7. A guest's buy names the list's owner. If the owner is the person raising it, "You already bought 1 pc extra"?
8. How a line covered by the extra draws at rest: drawn as the stepper at 0.
9. The count's word: "ud" / "uds" as the app writes "uds" today, or "ud." / "uds." with the period of the RAE abbreviation? And does the rule "every amount carries its unit" reach the stepper and the reel, which print a count bare today ("2")? Drawn bare, as built.
